svg.text: Single EC2 all-in-one deployment | x86_64 Marketplace AMI | CloudFormation delivery option
All application data remains in the buyer account
Network created by this CloudFormation template
Security group: inbound TCP 80/443 from AllowedWebCidr; no inbound SSH
Internet gateway + route table; outbound HTTPS enabled

g.text: Docker Compose: app, MariaDB, Redis, Qdrant,
OS + pre-pulled images; deleted with EC2
Database, files, vectors, secrets; snapshot on delete
Optional IAM access; off by default

svg.text: Solid blue/green: created by CloudFormation | Dashed gray: existing buyer resource or optional resource | Orange: external integration
Template creates one EC2 instance, security group, IAM role/profile, encrypted EBS data volume, SSM document and optional Data Lifecycle Manager policy.
